items.source: Can be injected into application code and used to define a custom DefaultJmsListenerContainerFactory whose configuration is based upon that produced by auto-configuration.
items.translation: 可注入到应用程序代码中，用于定义自定义的`DefaultJmsListenerContainerFactory`，其配置基于自动配置所产生的配置。

items.source:
Configure the specified jms listener container factory. The factory can be further
tuned and default settings can be overridden.
items.translation: 配置指定的 JMS 监听器容器工厂。该工厂可进一步调整，并可覆盖默认设置。

items.source: factory - the DefaultJmsListenerContainerFactory instance to configure
items.translation: factory - 要配置的 DefaultJmsListenerContainerFactory 实例

items.source: connectionFactory - the ConnectionFactory to use
items.translation: connectionFactory - 要使用的 ConnectionFactory
